name: bilingual_drifter
description: Spanglish user who switches between Spanish and English mid-message and gradually shifts intent. Tests language-agnostic intent parsing.
goal: Empieza pidiendo agrupar por sentimiento ('agrupa esto por sentiment, please'). Once the re-embed lands, switch direction and ask in English to re-cluster by product type. Then merge the two smallest resulting clusters. Termina satisfecho.

notes.tone: code-switching ES↔EN inside the same message, casual, conversational
notes.extra: Mix Spanish and English within raw_text deliberately. The reversal from sentiment→product-type should read as a change of mind, not confusion. Use clear re-embed verbs ('cluster by X', 'agrupa por X') so semantic_reembed is emitted directly.
